title: Grilled Egyptian Fish Skewers with Vibrant Vegetables
description: A flavorful and colorful dish featuring marinated fish and vegetables grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: Fish (400g)
ingredients.notes: Any white fish works well, such as tilapia or cod

ingredients.name: Vibrant Vegetables (bell peppers, onions, mushrooms)
ingredients.notes: Assorted colors for a pop of color

ingredients.name: Egyptian Skewers
ingredients.notes: Wooden or metal skewers work well

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Extra virgin for a rich flavor

instructions: Cut the fish into 1-inch cubes and place in a large bowl.
Add lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the bowl with the fish.
Mix well to combine and let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated fish and vibrant vegetables onto the Egyptian skewers.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as couscous or rice.
